requirement.description: RLP encoding/decoding functions have issues with handling certain data types and string modes, causing test failures in several test cases. Many tests fail due to improper handling of hex strings and encoding mismatches.
requirement.contract: Fix the rlp_encode and rlp_decode functions to properly handle various data types including integers, strings, and lists with correct str_mode handling. The functions should correctly encode/decode according to Ethereum RLP specifications.

requirement.description: Missing or improperly implemented cryptographic functions that require ecdsa and hashlib packages. Tests fail with ImportError when trying to use signature-related functions.
requirement.contract: Ensure that private_key_to_public_key, private_key_to_address, sign_message_hash, and get_signer_public_key functions properly handle missing dependencies by raising informative ImportError messages with installation instructions.

requirement.description: CREATE2 address calculation functions fail due to incorrect keccak hashing implementation and improper handling of hex data. Tests fail with ValueError for keccak hash computation.
requirement.contract: Fix get_created_address function to properly handle CREATE2 address calculations by ensuring correct data preparation and keccak256 hashing with proper error handling for invalid inputs.

requirement.description: Missing implementation for pack_vrs function that is referenced in tests but not implemented.
requirement.contract: Implement the pack_vrs function to properly pack V, R, S signature values according to Ethereum transaction format specifications.

requirement.description: Missing or incomplete format conversion functions that are needed for proper RLP encoding and other binary operations.
requirement.contract: Ensure all format conversion functions in formats.py are properly implemented to support binary operations, particularly hex conversions and keccak hashing.
